title: Drs. Carlene MacMillan and Owen Muir On the MedStory Podcast!
subtitle: We talk about working together as a couple in healthcare + technology
body_html:
Readers of this newsletter may have picked up on the fact that my wife, , is also my co-worker. At different times, I’ve been her boss, and she’s been mine. We have worked in the same company, and we have worked in different companies. Many people are curious about what this is like, and in this episode of the Med Story Podcast, you get to hear all about it.

I hope you enjoy it.

Rapid Acting Mental Health Treatment returns! Our next live-action newsletter event is on May 18th, along with the APA meeting in Los Angeles.

Our speakers include:

  • Grady Hannah, Co-Founder, Executive Team Member, Attentio AI, Co-Founder NightWare

  • Kellie Newsome, NP, co-host Carlat Psychiatry Podcast

  • Carlene MacMillan, M.D., DFAACAP, FCTMSS, Chief Product Officer at Radial

  • Daniel Karlin, M.D. Chief Medical Officer, MindMed

  • Jay Sanguinetti, Ph.D., Founder and President, Sanm.ai

  • Sandhya Prashad, M.D., Medical Director Houston Ketamine Therapeutics & Houston Deep TMS Therapy, President at American Society of Ketamine Physicians

  • Sarah Norman, Executive Director, BrainFutures . Former CMS

  • Chris Aiken, M.D., Director, Psych Partners. Editor of The Carlat Report

  • Oded Kraft, Co-founder, CEO and President at GrayMatters Health

  • Dominik Middelmann, Co-Founder & CEO MDHub

  • Jonathan Seltzer, CEO SimplePractice

  • Jonathan Downar, MD, Co-Founder, Ampa Health

  • Chris Dougherty, Founder and Chief Strategist at Hydra Strategies

Here are some clips from our last event in January! Stalwart supporters of RAMHT and audience favorites MDHub discuss their tool that I use every day…
